t: Werner 2.9m telescopic ladder combines professional-grade strength with practical convenience. This lightweight aluminium model extends from 0.78m to 2.9m and handles vertical loads up to 150kg, making it ideal for trade professionals tackling jobs across multiple heights. Single-handed unlock and automatic soft-close technology make for efficient set-up and takedown, whilst the built-in brace, non-slip feet and rectangular rungs ensure stability on site. At just 9.4kg, it transports easily between jobs.
b: Single-Handed Unlock with Automatic Soft-Close System
